_description: Sample: VAD mode with cascaded (non-realtime) model. Uses Azure Speech STT for audio input and Azure TTS for output. Compatible with GPT-5, GPT-4.1, and other non-realtime models.
_rationale: Cascaded mode provides broader model selection (GPT-5, GPT-4.1, Phi) with Azure Speech STT handling audio input. VAD mode recommended for reliable turn detection.
